659c2d7dbd09ad8aecad6e451f50231f70a39826.name: Sheraton Bali Kuta Resort Presents Finish-Line Maxxing Run &More
659c2d7dbd09ad8aecad6e451f50231f70a39826.description: On Sunday, 22 November 2026, Sheraton Bali Kuta Resort will gather Bali’s running community, hotel guests and local residents as they present Finish-Line Maxxing Run &More. The event combines active lifestyle, local culinary experiences, sustainable craftsmanship and community giving. Finish-Line Maxxing Run &More welcomes amateur to experienced runners to join a fun 5K social run , followed by a Coffee Rave Party at &More by Sheraton . Collaborating with the Erez Enterprize Community, the event will see up to 100 participants on a morning that combines running, coffee, food and music. In addition to the gathering, the activation is organised to support a neighbouring elementary school in Legian through a clothing donation initiative and to showcase gift bags created from repurposed hotel linen in collaboration with Tarum Bali and local artisans. Finish-LineMaxxing taps into Indonesia’s growing run club trend, and instead of establishing new running groups, Sheraton hotels decide to partner with existing clubs, turning the post-run cooldown into a social gathering focused on recovery and coffee culture. Hosted by Mika Affandy and Dominic Hulme , the morning commences with a casual 5K social run through Kuta and Legian starting at 6am , before reconvening at the resort for a post-run gathering until 10am .

6b116f702f8a8a5bece843d1c9e0a1540ef619c1.name: Santanera: El Quinto Aniversario Celebration
6b116f702f8a8a5bece843d1c9e0a1540ef619c1.description: On Thursday, 19 November 2026, Canggu’s beloved Latin American dining hotspot Santanera celebrates a new milestone with its fifth anniversary: El Quinto Aniversario . The celebration reunites founding chefs Andrés Becerra and Germ án Rinc ón for an evening of shared plates, floral installations and immersive performances, transitioning from dinner to a rooftop fiesta. At Santanera, a plate’s arrival at the table means an invitation to taste, exchange impressions, and pass it along. The experience is shaped by its vibrant Latin American flavours, generous hospitality, and the pleasure of gathering. With El Quinto Aniversario , Santanera will express greater pride in its roots through cooking, flowers, music and dance. Returning from his Spanish restaurant, Tinto, in Melbourne, fellow founding chef Germán Rincón reunites with founding chef Andrés Becerra to create a menu designed to share. The much-awaited reunion brings two culinary journeys back into the same kitchen, drawing on a shared foundation and the experiences they’ve gathered individually along the way.

a077bee4d5005d8bd6d7867d56de5f622156952d.name: Rooted in Bali: Black Garlic x Dapur Bali Mula
a077bee4d5005d8bd6d7867d56de5f622156952d.description: On Friday, 20 November 2026, a special culinary collaboration will take place between Black Garlic at Adiwana Alas Harum and Dapur Bali Mula, as the two culinary establishments present Rooted in Bali. A one-night dining event, Rooted in Bali celebrates Balinese culinary and cultural heritage through thoughtfully prepared dishes, storytelling, and the performing arts, offering guests a deeper understanding and appreciation of the island’s culinary roots and the traditions that continue to shape its identity. When it comes to food, there is a common thread shared universally: it tells the story of place, its people, and the traditions passed down through generations. In Bali, culinary heritage is deeply rooted in local ingredients, age-old cooking methods, and knowledge preserved within village communities.

5ab53ecef3f858ae33528468b77bde19108ebb8e.name: Beautiverse 2026: Green Beauty for the Future of Wellbeing
5ab53ecef3f858ae33528468b77bde19108ebb8e.description: From 18-20 December, Beautiverse 2026 returns to Bali, once again taking place at The Meru Sanur – Bali Beach Convention Centre, under the theme ‘Green Beauty for the Future of Wellbeing.’ This year, Beautiverse explores the evolution of the beauty industry towards a more holistic, conscious, and technology-driven approach. Over the three-day event, visitors can experience brand showcases, expert-led discussions, networking opportunities, and curated activities. The event also provides a platform for industry stakeholders to exchange ideas, build partnerships, and explore new opportunities across the beauty and wellness sectors. Featuring AI Ambassadors Tara, Bea, and Vexa as key highlights, Beautiverse introduces an innovative digital dimension to the experience. Beyond engaging audiences, these digital ambassadors reflect the growing relationship between artificial intelligence and the beauty and wellness industries. The Beautiverse App complements this initiative by providing information on the event, participating brands, programmes, and activities, creating a more interactive experience for visitors.

7b867e7d457fc4d9a977dc6058e28dc97a46a855.name: Padma Musical Series: George Harliono & Hera Hyesang Park
7b867e7d457fc4d9a977dc6058e28dc97a46a855.description: The Padma Musical Series returns this December with an evening of classical music featuring two acclaimed international artists: British-Indonesian pianist George Harliono and Korean soprano Hera Hyesang Park. Returning to Bali following his previous appearance at Padma Resort Legian, Harliono has established an impressive international career from a remarkably young age. In 2023, he received the Silver Medal at the XVII International Tchaikovsky Competition, one of the most prestigious events in the classical music world. His performance history includes celebrated venues such as Wigmore Hall, Royal Albert Hall, Berlin Philharmonie Kammermusiksaal and Suntory Hall, alongside appearances with orchestras including the NHK Symphony Orchestra, Tokyo Philharmonic Orchestra and Mariinsky Orchestra. Joining him for the December performance is Hera Hyesang Park, making her Bali debut. A Deutsche Grammophon recording artist and graduate of The Juilliard School, the Korean soprano has performed at leading opera houses and concert halls around the world, including the Metropolitan Opera, Staatsoper Berlin, Paris Opéra and Glyndebourne Festival. Her repertoire spans celebrated works including La bohème , La traviata , Don Giovanni and Le nozze di Figaro . Her debut album, I Am Hera , was released in 2020, followed by Breathe , which received the 2024 Opus Klassik Award for Videoclip of the Year.

650d7a24d0f3a0de879ba03462c62a335004e31a.description: A year after its inaugural charity gala helped fund a new school in Southwest Sumba, Sofitel Bali Nusa Dua Beach Resort is once again turning an evening of dining and celebration into an opportunity to give back. The resort will host its 2 nd Annual Charity Gala Dinner, An Evening of Purpose & Possibility, on 11 December 2026. Held from 6pm to 10pm at the Kecak Ballroom , the evening will bring together Bali’s hospitality and business communities, philanthropists, government representatives, media and influencers for a night of food, entertainment and purposeful giving. Last year’s gala, An Evening of Elegance & Empathy, raised IDR 500 million for Bali Life Foundation . The contribution helped fund a new school in Southwest Sumba, which was officially inaugurated in July 2026. Today, that school stands as a lasting reminder of what collective generosity can achieve.

0c998371382e6c3c83a4032bb713f94cc6e02dc4.name: Bali 1928: A Musical Journey Back in Time at Desa Potato Head
0c998371382e6c3c83a4032bb713f94cc6e02dc4.description: Bali’s extraordinary and otherworldly culture was once the island’s most enticing allure. Before beaches and resorts, it was dance, art, music and ceremony that captured the imagination – a vibrant way of life that intertwined nature and ritual into the everyday. The year was 1928, and such was this cultural fascination that German record labels Odeon and Beka sent engineers to Bali to capture a sound quite like anything they had heard before: the rhythmic reverberations of the gamelan, and the ethereal voices of Balinese song. Around this time, pioneering researchers like the ethnomusicologist Colin McPhee, artist and author Miguel Covarrubias, and art collector Rolf de Maré captured silent film footage of ceremonies, dancers and everyday life. For decades these lay in archives, unseen and unheard by those depicted. Fast forward to 2013. Dr. Edward Herbst, Arbiter of Cultural Traditions New York, together with ITB STIKON Bali, began a repatriation project, Arsip Bali 1928 , scoping the world for these recordings and bringing them back to Bali.
